_note: Broad anatomical bands for an adult domestic cat, ratios relative to withers height H (ground to top of shoulders) or head width. Measured on the SKIN (no fur). Deliberately wide: they exist to catch gross errors (greyhound torso, bug/buried eyes, pinhead), not to grade likeness. Sources: approximate veterinary/anatomy priors (adult cat: withers ~23-25 cm, head+body ~46 cm, tail ~25-30 cm, eyeball ~21 mm, head width ~8-9.5 cm). Changing a band goes through the ratchet (person's approval).
